reading_mnemonic: Koichi the konbini king kneels by his own patch of earth to <reading>coax</reading> the little stalk up, cooing 「<reading>こう</reading>」 until it sprouts and his face fills with <kanji form="幸">happiness</kanji>.
Brother <reading>Took</reading>, the temple monk, chants 「<reading>とく</reading>」 as he leads the one cow nobody may eat past the kitchen, because that cow is <kanji form="特">special</kanji>.
